content.value_statement: Marketing teams need clear content that matches brand voice and search goals. This skill provides templates, analysis scripts, and platform guidance for repeatable content production.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes existing text for brand voice traits, readability, sentence variety, and improvement recommendations.
Reviews draft content for keyword density, heading structure, links, readability, and SEO score.
Provides blog, case study, listicle, email, landing page, and video content frameworks.
Offers platform-specific social media guidance for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube.
Includes a content calendar template for campaign planning, publishing cadence, and KPI tracking.
Documents workflows for brand voice setup, SEO blog creation, social content, and monthly planning.
limitations: The SEO script uses local heuristics and does not fetch live search volume or ranking data.
Brand voice analysis depends on the quality and size of the supplied sample text.
The skill provides planning and drafting guidance, not legal, compliance, or trademark review.
Social media recommendations may need updates when platform algorithms or formats change.

use_cases.title: Plan a Campaign Calendar
use_cases.description: Build a monthly content calendar with themes, channels, deadlines, and measurable goals.

use_cases.title: Improve Search Content
use_cases.description: Review a draft article for keyword use, structure, readability, and practical SEO fixes.

use_cases.title: Keep Brand Voice Consistent
use_cases.description: Compare new copy with brand voice traits and identify tone, readability, and consistency gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Brand Voice
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this content for brand voice. Use the skill framework. Return a short profile, strengths, gaps, and three edits. Content: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Create an SEO Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an SEO blog outline for [topic] targeting [primary keyword]. Include a title, meta description, H2 sections, secondary keywords, and a publishing checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Repurpose for Social Channels
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn long-form content into platform posts
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this article into posts for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook. Keep one brand voice and apply platform-specific length and CTA guidance. Article: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full Content Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 30-day content plan for [audience] and [goal]. Include content pillars, weekly themes, SEO topics, social channels, measurement KPIs, and reuse paths.

output_examples.input: Analyze a product page draft for brand voice consistency.
output: Voice profile: professional and practical, with moderate readability.
Strength: clear benefits and direct calls to action.
Gap: several sections use generic claims without proof.
Recommendation: add customer outcomes, simplify long sentences, and standardize tone across headings.

output_examples.input: Optimize a blog post for the keyword “remote team onboarding”.
output: SEO score: good structure, but the keyword is missing from the first paragraph.
Recommended title: Remote Team Onboarding: A Practical Guide for Faster Ramp-Up.
Fixes: add two internal links, shorten long paragraphs, and include related terms in two H2 sections.

output_examples.input: Create social posts from a new thought leadership article.
output: LinkedIn: publish a concise insight post with one practical lesson and a discussion question.
X: create a short thread with one idea per post and a final call to read the article.
Instagram: use a carousel structure with a clear hook, three tips, and an action slide.

best_practices: Start with audience needs, target keywords, and the intended channel before drafting.
Run brand voice and SEO checks after the first draft, then revise with clear priorities.
Track performance metrics and use results to update future content calendars.
anti_patterns: Do not force keywords into every section when readability or usefulness suffers.
Do not reuse the same post unchanged across every social platform.
Do not treat the generated framework as a substitute for factual review and audience research.

faq.question: Does this skill write full articles?
faq.answer: It provides outlines, frameworks, optimization guidance, and drafting support. Final content still needs review and editing.

faq.question: Can it analyze brand voice from my existing copy?
faq.answer: Yes. The included analyzer reviews local text for tone, formality, readability, sentence variety, and consistency signals.

faq.question: Does the SEO optimizer use live search data?
faq.answer: No. It checks local content structure, keyword placement, density, links, readability, and meta suggestions.

faq.question: Which platforms are covered for social media?
faq.answer: The references include guidance for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and broader scheduling workflows.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it replace compliance review?
faq.answer: No. It includes basic best practices, but regulated industries should use legal and compliance review before publishing.
